summary: Android app: checkout keeps the cart
description: In the Android app shoppers add items to the cart and open the checkout screen. Going back from checkout returns to the cart without changing it.
acceptanceCriteria: After adding one item the cart shows Cart: 1 item.
Pressing the Android back button on the checkout screen returns to the cart, which still shows Cart: 1 item.
